visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two men are seated on a grey couch in a brightly lit studio environment. The man on the left wears a black corduroy jacket and holds a black smartphone, pointing at its screen while looking at his companion. The man on the right, dressed in a black denim shirt, looks at the phone with an intensely skeptical and surprised expression. A wooden coffee table with a silver laptop sits in the foreground. (2) A close-up shot transitions to golden french fries in a small wire basket against a vibrant red background. This is followed by a shot of oil bubbling rapidly in a deep fryer. (3) A still image of a hairless pink mouse is shown against a white background, which then cuts to a humorous animation of the mouse being engulfed in a cloud of dark grey smoke. (4) A video clip shows Donald Trump smiling at a table while a hand enters the frame to rub his blonde hair. This is followed by a screenshot of a social media post from X (Twitter) discussing a scientific study. (5) An animation of a character in black ninja-like garb gesturing with his hands appears. Then, a 3D medical-style animation shows black hair follicles growing out of a skin surface. (6) A comedic photo-edit shows a completely bald Donald Trump smiling broadly, with a small circular inset of the man from the studio looking shocked. (7) A movie poster for 'The Apprentice' (狂人法則) appears, showing lead actors against a New York City backdrop. (8) A rapid montage of movie clips follows, showing a young Donald Trump (played by Sebastian Stan) in business suits, interacting with an older man in offices, luxury cars, and elegant hallways. (9) The man on the left returns to the screen, gesturing energetically toward the camera. Animated orange fire graphics appear at the bottom of the frame as he speaks. (10) The final shot shows the full movie poster again with release dates and award nomination text overlays.

The BGM maintains a strong, synthetic four-on-the-floor beat. (3) A playful 'pop' sound effect is heard as the topic shifts to the hairless mouse. narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video leverages a viral internet trivia about Donald Trump and french fries to grab the audience's attention. It then strategically pivots to promote the biographical movie 'The Apprentice' (狂人法則), highlighting its controversial plot points and critical acclaim to encourage viewers to watch it in theaters upon its release.
